title: Body outline sheet
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: The human body and senses (Memory Box and Human Senses)
source: Seeded from science/y1 lesson 10 (Body outline sheet (portal printable; outline only, no face))
intro: Lesson 10: Parts of the human body. To understand that the human body has parts with names and jobs

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: Find the knee on the picture

parts.label: Step 2
parts.text: Draw a straight line from it

questions.q: Point to your shoulder. Show me!
questions.model: I find my arm. I follow it up to the top. That is my shoulder. I point to it.

questions.q: What joins your head to your body?
Label five parts on the body outline: head, neck, arm, knee, foot.
questions.a: Five correct labels with straight lines
questions.model: Teacher labels 'head' first: line from the head, write 'head'.

questions.q: Write what your hands help you do.
questions.a: For example: hold a cup, write, make wudu

questions.q: Big question: which part of your body do you use the most?
questions.a: Any part with a reason, for example: my hands, to eat and write
